A Biographical Dictionary of Later Han to the Three Kingdoms (23–220 AD) is a biographical dictionary by Rafe de Crespigny. It was published by Brill in 2006 as volume 19 in section 4 (China) of their  series.
Synopsis
Development
Developed in tandem with Michael Loewe's A Biographical Dictionary of the Qin, Former Han and Xin Periods (221 BC – AD 24).
